title: West Campus Stables
specs: Access to miles of trails along the ocean
Indoor/outdoor spacious stalls for every horse
Some horse experience required; no beginners accepted
Ability to ride and handle horses independently without supervision
Student riders must be confident working with horses and able to control a horse around others
Owning members must feed every horse on property one shift per week, clean stall at least 4x a week, refill hay box, monitor and clean water buckets
Members must complete 6 work hours per quarter and 4 chores per month (owning members) or 4 work hours per quarter (non-owning)
Cooperative model; members share chores, duties, and work hours to maintain facility

options.name: Boarding for UCSB Students, Faculty and Staff

services.name: Boarding for UCSB Students, Faculty and Staff

includes: Hay (orchard grass and alfalfa, 2 feedings a day)
Gear space in a locked tack room
Wheelbarrows and pitch forks for mucking
blurb: West Campus Stables is a co-op where members share horse care duties including feeding, mucking stalls, and maintenance. They offer boarding with stalls, hay, and gear space included, but members must provide additional feed and bedding. Student riders with horse experience can apply to help care for horses and participate in the co-op.
tags: Boarding for UCSB Students, Faculty and Staff
extraNote: Boarding applications accepted anytime; tours offered after preliminary approval · Student rider spots limited; applicants reviewed and contacted based on fit and availability · Hay fee $30 per month, adjusted based on hay prices; may be waived if prices drop · Located a 5 minute bike ride from UCSB main campus
